title: ClickDetector Interactions
summary: The classic click-to-interact: ClickDetector inside a part gives MouseClick (server+client) and hover events. Great for simple clickable objects; ProximityPrompt is preferred for new work.

explanation.whatItIs: Click detection as a component: parent it to a BasePart, connect MouseClick, done.
explanation.whyItExists: Predates ProximityPrompt; still the simplest 'click this thing' primitive and useful for cursor feedback.
whenToUse: Clickable levers/signs where a mouse click is the natural verb
whenNotToUse: As the primary interaction system for new games — prompts are more accessible (gamepad/touch)
tips: Pair with a Highlight or BillboardGui for affordance
Touch support: prompts handle it; ClickDetectors don't
commonMistakes: Handling clicks only client-side for gameplay effects
Expecting hover events on mobile (no cursor)

examples.title: Clickable button part
examples.code:
local button = workspace.BigRedButton
local cd = Instance.new("ClickDetector")
cd.MaxActivationDistance = 32
cd.Parent = button

cd.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
    print(player.Name, "pressed the button")
    -- authoritative effect here
end)

cd.MouseHoverEnter:Connect(function()
    button.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
end)
cd.MouseHoverLeave:Connect(function()
    button.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40)
end)
